property_summary: For any caller address X and any address A passed to setOwner, the reference contract only allows the initially-deployed admin to change owner (so owner can change via setOwner only when msg.sender == admin); the mutant removes that restriction and therefore for some fuzzed caller X the mutant allows owner to be set by non-admin callers while the reference does not.
change_summary: Change setOwner to remove the onlyAdmin modifier so any caller can set owner, altering the resulting owner after call.
